mapper.select:
SELECT t.subsidy_type, YEAR(t.subsidy_date) as year, SUM(t.money) as money FROM poor_subsidy t
and t.card_id=#{cardId} and t.card_id is not null
GROUP BY t.subsidy_type, YEAR (t.subsidy_date) order by subsidy_type

SELECT t.subsidy_type, YEAR(t.subsidy_date) as year, COUNT(t.card_id) as userCount FROM poor_subsidy t
and t.card_id=#{cardId} and t.card_id is not null
GROUP BY t.subsidy_type, YEAR (t.subsidy_date) order by subsidy_type

SELECT max(YEAR(t.subsidy_date)) as maxYear, min(YEAR(t.subsidy_date)) as minYear FROM poor_subsidy t
and t.card_id=#{cardId} and t.card_id is not null

select DISTINCT(t1.subsidy_type) as subsidy_type,t2.dict_label as subsidyTypeCN from poor_subsidy t1 left join sys_dict_data t2 on t1.subsidy_type=t2.dict_value
t2.dict_type='subsidy_type' and t1.card_id=#{cardId}

select t3.family_no,t3.relation_type,t1.card_id,
DATE_FORMAT(t1.subsidy_date,'%Y-%m') as subsidy_date,
DATE_FORMAT(t1.subsidy_date,'%Y') as subsidy_date,
t1.subsidy_type,SUM(t1.money) as money,t2.id,t2.`name` from poor_subsidy t1 left join poor_user t2 on t1.card_id=t2.card_id LEFT JOIN poor_family_user t3 on t1.card_id=t3.card_id
t2.card_id is not null
and t1.card_id like concat('%', #{cardId}, '%')
and t1.subsidy_type = #{subsidyType}
and (t1.subsidy_date >= #{dateRange[0]} and t1.subsidy_date <= #{dateRange[1]})
group by t3.family_no,t1.card_id,t1.subsidy_type order by t3.family_no,t3.relation_type,t1.card_id,t1.subsidy_type
group by t3.family_no,t1.card_id, DATE_FORMAT(t1.subsidy_date,'%Y-%m'),t1.subsidy_type order by t3.family_no,t3.relation_type,t1.card_id, DATE_FORMAT(t1.subsidy_date,'%Y-%m'),t1.subsidy_type
group by t3.family_no,t1.card_id, DATE_FORMAT(t1.subsidy_date,'%Y'),t1.subsidy_type order by t3.family_no,t3.relation_type,t1.card_id, DATE_FORMAT(t1.subsidy_date,'%Y'),t1.subsidy_type
mapper.delete: delete t1 FROM poor_subsidy t1 LEFT JOIN poor_user t2 ON t1.card_id = t2.card_id WHERE t2.id IS NULL
